prior.observation: Eight terminal Budget24 rows cut KL(Budget24||arm) by 74.0% but retained the wrong top-1, so recent higher-fidelity rows matter but a fixed eight-row tail is insufficient.

hypothesis: Budget20 corrupts the recurrent prompt trajectory cumulatively. A label-free periodic uniform-Budget24 refresh can limit that drift more efficiently than a terminal-only tail and restore the Budget24 first-token distribution below 1.2 logical GiB/provider-position.

arms.name: period4_first_token
arms.conditional: Run only if period8 misses Budget24 top-1 or fails to reduce KL toward Budget24.

protocol.first_token: Use max_tokens=1, schema rescue disabled, and compare full-vocabulary logits to the retained Budget24 reference.
protocol.full_generation: If a periodic arm passes top-1 and improves KL, rerun the 64-token weather fixture with the identical schedule and the already-validated declared-name schema rescue enabled.
protocol.no_tail_tuning: Do not add a longer fixed terminal tail or change the modulo phase on this discovery fixture.

gates.first_token_strong_go: Budget24 top-1 is restored, KL is reduced by at least 50% versus Budget20, and logical traffic is below 1.2 GiB/provider-position.
gates.first_token_partial_go: Budget24 top-1 is restored with positive KL reduction below 1.2 GiB/provider-position; permit the full-generation arm but do not claim distributional equivalence.
gates.full_generation_go: Exactly one valid get_weather call for San Francisco, at least one schema rescue marker, and sequence-average logical traffic below 1.2 GiB/provider-position.
gates.no_go: Period4 still misses Budget24 top-1, does not improve KL, or exceeds 1.2 logical GiB/provider-position. Stop periodic static refresh.
gates.next_if_full_go: Freeze the schedule and validate on held-out native-success coding, reasoning, multilingual, extraction and tool-declared fixtures before any production transplant.
gates.production: Discovery-fixture success is research evidence only.

limitations: The modulo schedule is label-free but static; it is a causal discriminator, not yet an adaptive risk oracle.
Budget24 is the behaviorally successful reference on this tool fixture, not native K3.
Cold timing is not serving throughput.
